en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the gym.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Let's get our bodies moving
Let's clean up a little
I'm tired...

A perfect idea.
I was thinking of training as well.

I must excel in many things if I wish to
complete all the requests given to me.

There may be a time when I am given
a task for battle, so I must train daily.

<CLT=cltMIND>Training for battle?
That seems a little...

<CLT=cltMIND>No, I guess it isn't that strange.
This is Kirumi, after all.

That is part of a maid's duty.
You do not need to worry about it.
I do not mind if you truly wish to...
...No. Please leave the cleaning to me.

Do not take it the wrong way,
but when you clean... I...

If that is the case, then perhaps you should
rest back at the dormitory.

I do not wish to nag, especially about
what just happened...

...but, I would like to give you my advice on
what you should not do in the future.

You have a maid at your beck and call. It would
make me happy if you kept that in mind.

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Kirumi looks deep in thought...
(How should I...?)
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Kirumi's inner thoughts...?
